{{Top|leg}}
'''Kon'meas Spaceport''' was the main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]].<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

Situated a few hundred kilometers south of the [[Northern Sea (Bal'demnic)|Northern Sea]], on the planet's primary landmass, it formed the southernmost outskirts of the [[Unidentified Bal'demnic city|larger city]], nesting on high cliffs overlooking the azure beaches. The city itself was surrounded by high walls, perched among the homes of the elite [[Kon'me]] and deforested hills.<ref name="DP" />

The native Kon'me of both the higher and lower classes frequented the spaceport, as well as travelers from neighboring star systems, some hailing from as far as the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], though mostly [[Non-huMan|non-Humans]].<ref name="DP" />

The spaceport exhibited a shabby and outdated appearance, consisting of modular buildings, prefabricated hangars and warehouses, and illuminated landing pads for both freighters and passenger vessels. Cubicle [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]], dubious [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafes]] and dark [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] lined the streets.<ref name="DP" />

Security of the facility was fairly lax, with Kon'me guards oft found to be sleeping on duty, and the technology antiquated.<ref name="DP" />

After killing his master [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] traveled hundreds of kilometers on foot to the spaceport, stowing aboard a freighter from [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] designated the ''[[Woebegone]]'' to secure passage to [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]].<ref name="DP" />
